title: 第六章闭关修炼
slug: 洪荒无量道全本免费-洪荒无量道最新章节列表
content_zh:
“看来有点落后了，虽然这点时间在修道之人眼中不过是眨眼一瞬间，但是对现在的玄元来说时间就有点紧迫了。你道为何?还不是寿元问题，别以为修道成仙了就仙福永享，寿与天齐了，这些都是放屁，如果这样，洪荒之中该有多少仙人，即便洪荒再大，天地灵气也供不起这样的消耗。因此寿元问题也是修道路上的一个阻碍仙道以下，倒是不成问题，现在洪荒之中先天灵气充沛，即便是一头猪，在百年千年之内都可以修成地仙了，现在可不是后世那种没有灵气的时代，连千年以上的灵草灵药几乎都断绝了。因此，修成地仙是不难，而在成仙之后，你就别以为寿元无尽了，有一道关卡几乎横断了所有修行之人多前路，决定着你能否向更高的境界迈进，度过了才是真正的寿元无尽，以后都不用担心寿元问题；度不过，轻则兵解入轮回，重则灰飞烟灭。
这一道关口就是金仙境界了，成仙之后，后面的境界有地仙、天仙、真仙、玄仙、金仙，在金仙之前，都有寿元极限，以一元会十二万九千六百年为限，在这个时间内，如果没有达到金仙境界，天地都会降下大劫，称之为元会之劫，除非你有续命神药，或者有大神通者为你续命，否则劫数难过。金仙号称金性不朽，寿元无限，也可称为不朽金仙，是修道路上的一个重要关卡，洪荒之中能达到这一境界的无一不是资质超凡之辈，前途无量，不可小觑。而且还是这样一个天道不出，天地压制的时代，完全是靠自己摸索修炼而成，比之后世那些有师门长辈教导的弟子可是艰苦多了。
“现如今自己已经落后了有十万载岁月，虽然自己的元神已经十分强大，但还是尽快创出功法修炼成仙，摆脱寿元限制吧！”玄元如今还未成仙，当修成仙之后才会有元会之劫出现，也就是又有十二万载的时间，不然的话又要创功法，又要修炼，时间还真是不够的。“自己强大的元神倒是给自己带来了好处，不成仙依然能存在那么久，还真是异数。”想到此，玄元也不禁感到庆幸，回到之前的闭关之处，“现在没有法力，还无法炼制出宫殿房子之类的住所，还是将就一下，住洞府吧！”没有法力，炼器之法也不知，玄元也感到很无奈。静下心来，玄元把心神沉入造化青莲的道韵中，感悟其中的法则，结合自身，开始了漫长的闭关历程。
道可道，非常道。名可名，非常名。无名天地之始，有名万物之母。故常无欲以观其妙；常有欲以观其徼。此两者同出而异名，同谓之玄，玄之又玄，众妙之门。天地不仁，以万物为刍狗；圣人不仁，以百姓为刍狗。天地之间，其犹橐龠乎﹖虚而不屈，动而愈出。多言数穷，不如守中上善若水。水善利万物而不争，处众人之所恶，故几于道。居善地，心善渊，与善仁，言善信，政善治，事善能，动善时。夫唯不争，故无尤。
随着玄元进入闭关，玄元所在的山谷回复以往的平静，寂静的山谷随着时间的流逝，长满灵药灵根，焕发出勃勃生机。一千年，一万年，三万年……转眼自玄元闭关至今已有三万载岁月，小山谷中也随着时间的流逝，生机越来越旺盛，闭关之前都还没有多少上了年龄了灵药灵根，如今已经绿意盎然，随着天地的压制减弱这些灵草灵药生长变得越来越快，这些成熟的灵药若在后世必将会有不知多少人为之厮杀。闭关的洞府中一句句大道真言在识海中想起，玄元静静聆听，元神通达，陷入了顿悟之境，这是玄元第一次真正意义上的修道，所获颇多。

"It seems a bit behind. Although this time is just a blink of an eye in the eyes of cultivators, for Xuanyuan now, time is a bit urgent. Why do you think? It is not a matter of longevity. Don't think that if you become an immortal as a cultivator, you will enjoy eternal blessings and live as long as heaven. These are all farts. If so, how many immortals would there be in the prehistoric world? No matter how great the prehistoric world is, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth cannot afford such consumption. Therefore, the issue of longevity is also an obstacle on the path to immortality. It is not a problem. Now the innate spiritual energy in the prehistoric world is full. Pei, even a pig can become an Earth Immortal within a hundred and a thousand years. Now is not the age without spiritual energy in later generations. Even the spiritual herbs and elixirs that have been used for more than a thousand years have almost been cut off. Therefore, it is not difficult to become an Earth Immortal, but after becoming an immortal, you should not expect to live long. Life is endless. There is a barrier that almost cuts off the path forward for all practitioners. It determines whether you can move to a higher realm. Once you have passed it, you will truly have endless life. You will not have to worry about longevity in the future. If you fail to pass it, you will be disbanded in reincarnation, or you will be wiped out.
This pass is the Golden Immortal realm. After becoming an Immortal, the following realms include Earth Immortal, Heavenly Immortal, True Immortal, Mysterious Immortal, and Golden Immortal. Before the Golden Immortal, there is a lifespan limit, which is limited to Yiyuanhui for 129,600 years. Within this time, if you do not reach the Golden Immortal realm, heaven and earth will bring down a great calamity, which is called the Yuanhui calamity. Unless you have a life-extending magic medicine, or someone with great supernatural powers can extend your life for you, otherwise the calamity will be difficult. The Golden Immortal is said to be immortal in nature and has unlimited lifespan. It can also be called the Immortal Golden Immortal. It is an important step in the path of cultivation. Those who can reach this state in the ancient times are all people with extraordinary qualifications. Their future is boundless and cannot be underestimated. Moreover, it is still in such an era when the law of heaven cannot come out and the heaven and earth suppress it. It is completely dependent on self-exploration and cultivation, which is much more difficult than those disciples in later generations who have the guidance of their elders.
"Now I am already a hundred thousand years behind. Although my soul is already very powerful, I still have to create a technique as soon as possible to become an immortal and get rid of the limitation of lifespan! "Xuan Yuan has not yet become an immortal. The catastrophe of the Yuan Hui will not occur until he becomes an immortal, which means there will be another 120,000 years. Otherwise, he has to create techniques and practice, which is really not enough time. "My powerful Yuan Shen has brought benefits to me. It is really unusual that a non-immortal can still exist for such a long time. "Thinking of this, Xuanyuan couldn't help but feel lucky and returned to his previous retreat, "Now that I don't have magic power, I can't refine a palace or a house, so I'd better make do with it and live in a cave! "Having no magic power and not knowing how to refine weapons, Xuanyuan also felt helpless. After calming down, Xuanyuan sank his mind into the Taoist charm of Qinglian, understood its laws, combined with himself, and began a long process of retreat.
The Tao can be Tao, but it is very Tao. Famous, very famous. The beginning of the nameless heaven and earth, the name of the mother of all things. Therefore, I always have no desire to observe its wonderfulness; I always have the desire to observe its beauty. These two have the same origin but different names. They are both called xuan, and xuan is xuan again. They are the door to all mysteries. The heaven and the earth are unkind and regard all things as stupid dogs; the saints are unkind and regard the common people as stupid dogs. Between heaven and earth, it is like a quarrel? If it is empty but not yielding, it will get better when it moves. It is better to keep the best of things like water than to talk too much. Water is good for all things and does not compete with it. It is disliked by everyone, so it is close to the Tao. Live in a good place, have a good heart, be kind and benevolent, speak good words and have good faith, govern well, do good things and be able to do good things at the right time. The husband does not fight, so there is no need for you.
As Xuanyuan entered seclusion, the valley where Xuanyuan was located returned to its previous peace. As time passed, the silent valley became filled with elixir roots and became full of vitality. One thousand years, ten thousand years, thirty thousand years... In the blink of an eye, it has been thirty thousand years since Xuanyuan retreated. As time goes by, the life in the small valley is becoming more and more vigorous. Before the retreat, there were not many elixirs and spiritual roots. Now they are full of green. With the skyAs the suppression of the earth weakens, the growth of these spiritual herbs and elixirs becomes faster and faster. If these mature elixirs are used in future generations, countless people will fight for them. In the cave of retreat, the mantras of the Great Dao came to mind in the sea of ​​consciousness. Xuanyuan listened quietly, and his soul was enlightened. He fell into a state of enlightenment. This was Xuanyuan's first true Taoist practice, and he gained a lot.
